title: Summer Beach Clipart
author: Hippo and Kiwi Studio
description:
Summer Clipart, Summer Beach Clipart, Summer and Beach Clipart
Looking for the perfect summer clipart to add some sunshine to your designs?
Look no further than our collection of 28 summer clipart images!
Each image is provided in PNG format and boasts a high resolution of 300 DPI, ensuring that your designs will look crisp and vibrant.
Use these images to create invitations, posters, or even social media graphics that capture the essence of summer.
From beach balls to ice cream cones, this summer clipart collection has everything you need to bring a touch of warmth and relaxation to your designs. 
You will receive the following:
– 28 PNGs with transparent background
-300 DPI
-Size: Clipart come in a variety of sizes. The largest is 8 inches.
